title: Engineering with AI in the Stack
summary: A candid conversation on integrating AI into production engineering. I shared lessons on building structural scaffolding, navigating new bottlenecks in code review and on-call, and where human judgment remains critical.

title: Ask an SRE: Lessons from the Frontlines

title: Life of an SRE
